# darce.xyz
> Portfolio and case studies for Daniel Arcé.
> Design technologist building AI and data-rich products across interaction design, accessibility, prototyping, and implementation.

## Pages
- / — Home
- /work/ — Index of project case studies
- /about/ — Bio, role focus, strengths
- /research/ — Index of technical writing and experiments

## Projects
- /projects/semantic-image-search/ — Native macOS product for semantic search and visual exploration, with on-device processing and explicit states for incomplete data, indexing, model availability, and partial library access.
- /projects/photoshelter/ — R&D prototyping that cut downstream implementation effort by an internal estimate of roughly 30%, and WCAG 2.1 audit and remediation on contracts worth a combined $9.2M ARR that were exposed if compliance could not be demonstrated, across a media platform serving 80,000+ users and 1B+ files.
- /projects/workbay/ — Coding agents forget the work that matters when a session ends. WorkBay makes task, review, decision, and test state durable and portable across agent tools.
- /projects/apple/ — Built launch-critical landing pages, a CSS-animated email campaign, and internal workflow tooling for Apple’s iPhone X release
- /projects/msnbc/ — Prototyped and shipped a live video platform under a six-month deadline for a major broadcast news network
- /projects/barbarabeirne/ — Recovered a photography archive from a defunct Flash site, rebuilt the portfolio, and later rewrote the live site with Web Components
- /projects/bauhausdances/ — Designed a visual identity rooted in the film’s source material and built a custom WordPress theme with self-hosted video

## Research
- /research/agent-memory/ — How WorkBay keeps coding-agent memory in a per-repo SQLite database any agent tool can read. Structured rows are the canonical record; semantic embeddings are an index over them.
- /research/interrogating-agent-memory/ — An observational readout of production handoff databases. The five recurring questions that semantic search over durable agent state actually gets asked, each grounded in what the record holds.
- /research/economics-of-agent-memory/ — The claim that durable, vendor-agnostic agent memory reduces token spend, stated as a falsifiable hypothesis with its measurement design, registered before the measurement has been run.
- /research/heuristics-canon/ — A working research corpus that turns recurring product, interaction, accessibility, AI, and engineering decisions into checkable rules with stable IDs and source provenance.
- /research/rotation-matrices/ — A browser experiment that makes rotation matrices and perspective projection, normally abstracted by WebGL, visible using only TypeScript, DOM elements, and CSS transforms
- /research/order-book/ — An interactive guide to bids, asks, spread, and visible market depth using live Binance WebSocket data
